facts.statement: Free Realms ran a Double Station Cash promotion in Europe: redeeming SOE Pre-Paid PC Game Cards in the window gave double Station Cash (SC).
facts.quote: Redeem SOE Pre-Paid Game Cards anytime between October 7th, 2011 and October 10th, 2011 to get Double SC*.

article_summaries.title: European Double Station Cash (Free Realms - ¿Qué novedades hay?)
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language Free Realms news post (freerealms.com, captured Nov 2011) announcing a Double Station Cash promotion for redeeming SOE Pre-Paid PC Game Cards in Europe. The redemption window was October 7 to October 10, 2011 (CET), and the offer applied only to cards bought from participating European retailers. The post carries no explicit publication date beyond its relative 'hace 4 semanas' stamp.
